title: Brown spent his career looking for a nuclear power source

tellings.quote: the funny thing about Brown is he was looking for a power source that was nuclear for like the rest of his career.

plain: The scientist Thomas Townsend Brown, known for his anti-gravity experiments, is said to have spent the rest of his career searching for a power source that was nuclear. Michels mentions it himself, as a passing aside while discussing Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft, and he names no source. To Michels it is a curious echo of the power questions in Lazar's story.
